scripts.prepare:workspace: pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-docs dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-basic dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-i18n dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-search dev:prepare && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-search-i18n dev:prepare && pnpm prepare:contracts
scripts.benchmark:search: pnpm build:packages && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-playground-i18n build && node --expose-gc benchmarks/search/benchmark.mjs
scripts.example: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const target = process.argv[1]; if (!target) { console.error('Usage: pnpm example <group>/<name>'); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync('pnpm', ['--dir', `examples/${target}`, 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:repo-policies && pnpm run check:test-selection && pnpm run api-docs:check && eslint .
scripts.release:verify: node scripts/timed-command.mjs verify pnpm verify && node scripts/timed-command.mjs browser-e2e pnpm test:e2e:browser:prepared && node scripts/timed-command.mjs generate pnpm test:generate:static:prepared && node scripts/timed-command.mjs audit:prod pnpm audit:prod && node scripts/timed-command.mjs release:pack pnpm release:pack && node scripts/timed-command.mjs pure-runtimes pnpm test:pure-runtimes && node scripts/timed-command.mjs consumer:pnpm pnpm test:package-consumer && node scripts/timed-command.mjs consumer:npm pnpm test:package-consumer:npm && pnpm release:certify
scripts.test:golden: pnpm build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project contracts-node test/contracts/provider-route-golden.test.ts
scripts.test:compatibility-slice: pnpm release:pack && pnpm test:package-consumer && pnpm test:generate:static && pnpm test:search:matrix
scripts.test:minimum-runtime: pnpm build:packages && pnpm prepare:contracts && pnpm test:prepared && pnpm test:quickstart:prepared && pnpm test:pr-e2e-smoke:prepared
scripts.test:quickstart: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-quickstart dev:prepare && pnpm test:quickstart:prepared
scripts.test:search:matrix: pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project e2e test/e2e/search-matrix.test.ts
scripts.test:sitemap:static: pnpm vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project e2e test/e2e/sitemap-static.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-content-test-typecheck dev:prepare && pnpm typecheck:prepared
scripts.test:prepared: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project provider --project contracts-node --project runtime --project client --project nuxt
scripts.test:watch: vitest watch --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project provider --project contracts-node --project runtime --project client --project nuxt
scripts.verify:core:prepared: pnpm test:prepared && pnpm typecheck:prepared && pnpm test:quickstart:prepared
scripts.verify:core: pnpm build:packages && pnpm prepare:contracts && pnpm verify:core:prepared
scripts.verify:docs-examples:prepared: pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:smoke && pnpm examples:build
scripts.verify: pnpm dev:prepare && pnpm verify:static && pnpm verify:docs-examples:prepared && pnpm verify:core:prepared && pnpm verify:e2e
